provenance.inputs: all inputs are literals in the capture program, and each case embeds its inputs next to its outputs
capture_notes: every input record is pre-stamped (event_id, ts) so the sealed chain is deterministic; the Log clock is fixed at the Unix epoch and is not observed by those records
verification[].expected is Go SelfVerify semantics: Verify, then VerifyWitness when a witness key is given
stamps[] appends one unstamped record to a fresh Log whose clock is time.Unix(0, unix_nanos); event_id_prefix keeps only the 48-bit millisecond field because the rest is random
the signing seed is 32 bytes of 0x11 and the witness seed 32 bytes of 0x22; the HMAC key is the ASCII text fm14-hmac-key-<node>
